head_commit.message:
Add gated enterprise audit OTEL fan-out

- codex-rs/config/src/config_requirements.rs: thread enterprise_audit_enabled through requirements parsing, merging, defaults, and normalization.
- codex-rs/core/src/config/mod.rs: expose Config::enterprise_audit_enabled() from the requirements layer.
- codex-rs/core/src/features.rs: add the default-off enterprise_audit local feature flag and schema metadata.
- codex-rs/core/src/otel_init.rs: build a logs-only enterprise audit OTEL provider, derive the canonical /api/codex/audit URL, and reuse auth headers.
- codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs: retain the enterprise audit OTEL provider for CLI process lifetime and attach its logger layer.
- codex-rs/app-server/src/lib.rs: retain the enterprise audit OTEL provider for app-server process lifetime and attach its logger layer.
- codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/v2.rs: expose enterpriseAuditEnabled in configRequirements/read as an experimental field.
- codex-rs/app-server/src/config_api.rs: map enterprise_audit_enabled into the configRequirements/read response.
- codex-rs/app-server/README.md: document the enterpriseAuditEnabled configRequirements/read field.
- codex-rs/cloud-requirements/src/lib.rs: extend requirements parsing coverage for enterprise_audit_enabled.
- codex-rs/core/src/config/config_tests.rs: cover enterprise audit config and feature gating behavior.
- codex-rs/core/src/config_loader/tests.rs: cover system requirements loading of enterprise_audit_enabled.
- codex-rs/otel/tests/suite/otlp_http_loopback.rs: verify OTLP JSON audit export to /api/codex/audit with auth headers.
- codex-rs/tui/src/debug_config.rs: keep debug config normalization aware of the new requirements field.
- codex-rs/core/config.schema.json: regenerate config schema entries for enterprise_audit.

head_commit.message:
feat: improve skills cache key to take into account config layering (#14806)

Fix https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/14161

This fixes sub-agent [[skills.config]] overrides being ignored when
parent and child share the same cwd. The root cause was that turn skill
loading rebuilt from cwd-only state and reused a cwd-scoped cache, so
role-local skill enable/disable overrides did not reliably affect the
spawned agent's effective skill set.

This change switches turn construction to use the effective per-turn
config and adds a config-aware skills cache keyed by skill roots plus
final disabled paths.
